plugins/pdstack/skills/setup-pdstack/scr.why: Node port of check-sheet.sh and check-sheet.awk, because pdstack scripts are Node only (spec sections 9 and 13). Same CLI, default sheet, output, and exit codes. Also checks family lines and `<family>:<model>` values through sheet.mjs (spec section 10).
Node port, because pdstack scripts are Node only (spec sections 9 and 13). Same CLI, output, and exit codes. The decoder lives in sheet.mjs.

Node port, because pdstack scripts are Node only (spec sections 9 and 13). Also holds the decoder of read-sheet.sh. Reads the roles from models.json at run time in place of the stamped list. Drops the shell reader hooks (`sheet_read`, `sheet_quote`), because v1 has no hook. Accepts `family <name>: <command>` lines and `<family>:<model>` role values (spec section 10): a family entry needs a family line, a family line needs a valid name and `{model}` in its command, and a family counts as one vendor in a panel. Accepts a missing role line, because the sheet says that a deleted line falls back to the skill default, and the upstream rule is for the Copilot hook that v1 does not ship.

plugins/pdstack/skills/setup-pdstack/SKI.why: Spec sections 9 and 10. Removes step 4 (the session hook) and the `session hook` line and its mentions in the sheet header, step 7, step 8, and Other runtimes. Step 4 now adds model families: CLI detection on PATH, `family <name>: <command>` lines, `<family>:<model>` role values, one test call for each model through `scripts/run-external.mjs`, the offer to put a new family in the cross-family roles, and the Claude-only gap statement in step 8. Step 6 runs the Node `check-sheet.mjs` after the write. New step 11 detects stack packs, asks for the worktree home, writes `.agents/pdstack.json` with only the keys that differ from the defaults, and validates it with `check-config.mjs`. New step 12 makes `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md` and `docs/agents/domain.md` when absent, which replaces setup-matt-pocock-skills. The description names the new jobs. Drops the Codex, Pi, Copilot, and Muse mapping text, because pdstack v1 supports Claude Code only. The sheet and the default panel have no `fable`.

plugins/pdstack/skills/statechart/script.why: Drops the fast-check devDependency, because pdstack does not copy the config-fuzz and differential tests that need it, and the Node scripts have no dependencies.

plugins/pdstack/skills/thermo-nuclear-re.why: Adds Concurrency Guidelines, because the review gate in opening-a-pr runs this skill, and an eval on 11 cases showed that one-pass reviews miss interleaving bugs (issue #14). Keeps `user-invocable: false` in the frontmatter, which the `hide` flag added before.
